title: Israeli double-tap strike kills 15-year-old and paramedic in Gaza
content: Israeli double-tap strike kills 15-year-old and paramedic in Gaza | Genocide | Al Jazeera Toggle Play Israeli double-tap strike kills 15-year-old and paramedic in Gaza A 15-year-old boy has been killed in an apparent Israeli double-tap strike as he rushed to help a paramedic wounded in an attack moments before. Israel has killed around one child per day in Gaza since the 2025 ‘ceasefire’.
